target_frame.crs: EPSG:28191 Palestine Grid metres (= WBADB Old Israel Grid minus 1,000,000 m N)

pick_notes.RP-TELL-FOOT-W: map: outer edge of the hachured tell outline on the line N 142050; reference: west edge of the bare excavated mound at the tree line on the same line
pick_notes.RP-TELL-FOOT-S: map: outer edge of the outline on the line E 192150; reference: south edge of the bare mound on the same line
pick_notes.RP-TELL-FOOT-E: map: outer edge of the outline on the E-W line through the spring dot; reference: east edge of the bare mound on the E-W line through the reference spring point
pick_notes.RP-TAWAHIN: map: centre of the oval outline beside the 'Sugar Mills / Et Tawāḥīn' label (the label is the identity check); reference: centre of the walled ruin complex west-north-west of the tell
pick_notes.RP-MEFJAR: map: centre of the square 'R.' symbol south-west of the 'Khirbat el Mafjar' label; reference: centre of the palace's square main building
pick_notes.RP-SPRING: map: the spring dot beside 'Sp.' and 'ʿEin es Sultān'; reference: northernmost point of the rounded north end of the orange-roofed elongated structure east of the road (identified as the spring house and reservoir: INFERENCE, moderate confidence)

dropped_candidates.RP-SAMARAT: the map shows it (trig 836 on a mound symbol), but no mound is identifiable on the reference imagery; dropped under the rule written before the fit (a feature not identifiable on the reference is dropped)
dropped_candidates.RP-ABU-HINDI: the map labels it with a small mound symbol, but no mound is identifiable on the reference imagery; dropped under the same rule
dropped_candidates.RP-ROADS: not used: the road alignments near the tell changed
dropped_candidates.RP-TELL-FOOT-N: excluded by role and inside the mask

deviation_note: Identification-based drops were decided before any fit or residual was computed. No control was chosen or dropped by its residual.
